title: Random Number Generator
h1: Random Number Generator — Pick Numbers in a Range
description: Generate random integers or decimals within a custom range. Optional unique numbers. Private and instant.
intro: Set the minimum, maximum and how many numbers you need. Get cryptographically random results.
blurb: Generate one or more random numbers in any range.
howItWorks: Enter the lower and upper bounds.
Choose how many numbers to produce.
Optionally require unique values. Click Generate.
examples: Min 1, max 6, count 1 simulates a die roll.
Min 0, max 100, count 5 with unique gives five different numbers.
Decimals are supported if you use non-integer bounds.

faq.a: Yes. The generator uses the browser's crypto.getRandomValues for cryptographic randomness.

faq.q: What happens if unique is checked and the range is too small?
faq.a: The tool reports an error if it cannot produce enough unique numbers.
No. Generation is local and the page keeps no history.
